messages:
Alex M (Marketing): Draft of the Redwood Optimize blog is up: https://docs.google.com/example — quick asks: 1) legal + eng sign-off on benchmark claims by EOD Thu, 2) confirm webinar CTA and speakers, 3) HubSpot routing for inbound leads. Please skim headline and first two sections.
Priya K (Growth PM): On it. Quick note: avoid 'guarantee' language in headline. Use 'observed' or 'measured'.
Diego R (Eng-ML): I pulled the evals — numbers look right for the synthetic tests. We should qualify: 2.4x token cost reduction observed on instruction-following workloads vs the baseline 13B float model. I'll add a brief methodology paragraph.
Alex M (Marketing): Thanks Diego — can you add the one-sentence methodology under the benchmarks section? Also Kevin/legal: any early flags?
Kevin S (Legal): I'll review. Things to watch: comparative claims need a baseline definition and timeframe. If customer logos or quotes are used, ensure permissions. Also avoid absolute statements like 'guarantees 2.4x'.
Alex M (Marketing): Agreed. Will switch phrasing to 'in our benchmark suite we observed up to 2.4x reduction...' and add baseline note. Elaine — we have a customer quote in the doc, can CS confirm permissions are cleared?
Elaine T (Customer Success): I can confirm we have written permission for the quote but need to confirm the exact snippet. I'll DM the customer and cc legal. Should have it by tomorrow morning.
Priya K (Growth PM): Webinar planning: propose 'Benchmarks Deep Dive: How Teams Cut Inference Cost' — target date two weeks out. Speakers: Sarah (PM) and Daniel (Lead Research). Can we lock them?
Diego R (Eng-ML): Both are available that week. Recommend including a short appendix with the benchmark methodology and config (dataset, sequence lengths, quantization settings).
Alex M (Marketing): Good — I'll link the appendix. Also need HubSpot routing: new source tag 'optimize_launch_2026' and route to SDR queue 'bench-inbound'. Can someone from ops set that up? Example config below.
MarketingBot: Reminder: prepend all external links with UTM tags. Use /utm_builder to generate params. :memo:
Alex M (Marketing): HubSpot workflow snippet (for ops):
```
workflow_name: optimize_launch_2026
trigger: form_submission
assign_to: bench-inbound
tags: [optimize, benchmark]
utm_source: newsletter
```
Priya K (Growth PM): I'll create the webinar registration form and embed the utm + hidden field 'source=optimize_launch_2026'. Will share draft by EOD.
Kevin S (Legal): Quick flag on customer quote: please send me the full context and draft for review once Elaine gets written permission. I'll aim to turn around within 24 hrs.
Alex M (Marketing): Thanks everyone. Deadline: please leave final copy comments in the doc by tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. If no objections, we'll publish the post, notify partners, and enable the HubSpot workflow. Short hero paragraph (to iterate):
"Redwood Optimize helps engineering teams reduce inference unit costs while preserving model quality. In our benchmark suite, teams saw up to 2.4x token-cost reduction and lower median latency for common instruction-following workloads. Join our deep-dive webinar to see the methodology and real customer results."
Priya K (Growth PM): Suggest shorten first sentence to 'Redwood Optimize reduces inference cost while preserving model quality.' And add CTA: 'Register for the webinar — spots limited.'
Alex M (Marketing): Updated doc with Priya's tweaks. Thanks — I'll ping when legal + customer quotes are green.
